verdict.rationale: No evidence of a rules/automation engine where users define event-triggered actions (e.g., webhook-style triggers, if-this-then-that automations). ReadMe's 'rules' evidence (Linter, Docs Audit) are natural-language style checks applied on-demand or in audits, not event-triggered automation actions; GitHub AI Writer watches PRs but isn't user-defined rule-based automation. Missing for 10: any documented trigger/action automation framework, event-based workflow builder, or user-configurable automation rules tied to arbitrary events.
